findings.what: Freed slot is not held while an offer is pending; public booking can take it before the waitlisted patient accepts (handled by voiding and requeueing, documented as interim).
Duplicate-join check is read-then-insert with no unique index; concurrent identical joins can create duplicate waitlist entries.
Recording leave does not touch waitlist entries for the doctor's leave dates; they stay 'waiting' indefinitely without notification.
removeWaitlistEntry does not validate the id as a UUID; a malformed id causes an uncaught Postgres cast error (500) instead of NOT_FOUND.
Offer expiry sweep runs every 5 minutes, so pass-along to the next patient can lag up to ~35 minutes after sending rather than 30.
PRD 4.3 says staff can cancel/reschedule at any time from the portal, but no general staff cancel/reschedule for booked appointments exists (only reassign, walk-in, and leave-affected cancel).
